decisions.reason: F2 incorrectly identified the closed geometric simplex with the affine image of an open simplex. Its interior claim is true: the simplex contains the image of {t_i>0, sum t_i<1} under an affine homeomorphism. Corrected F2 and explicitly used convexity to put this open subset in C. Proper closed affine spans handle empty interior; finite-volume homothetic contractions handle nonempty interior. Statement unchanged; countable choice retained.

F2 attributed uniform integrability to a supplier whose Statement gives contiguity, although its proof contains the needed truncation argument. Replaced F2 by dominated convergence and supplied the argument directly: EU_n tends to EU=1, clipped expectations converge, and the tail at 2Q is bounded by twice E(U_n-Q)+. Work on eventual finite-mean indices suffices; finitely many possibly infinite early errors are irrelevant. Checked measurability, positive compact minima, predictive tails and normalization, including singular K and predictively null zero denominators. Statement unchanged.

F1 overstated the contiguity supplier Statement by including UI, but that supplier proves the needed tail argument. Corrected F1 and proved UI explicitly using clipped weak expectations, matching mean Ee^Z=1, the bound x 1{x>2M} <= 2(x-M)+, and dominated convergence. Clipping then transfers bounded continuous expectations. Added explicit product-law/Tonelli/Borel-Lebesgue suppliers for the coordinate density used in the Gaussian tilt; translation shifts the mean by Bb=tau without inverting Sigma. Verified sigma=0, singular Sigma and the contiguity direction. Statement unchanged.

F4 claimed a Lebesgue density from the Gaussian definition, which only supplies the affine independent-coordinate realization. Corrected F4 and derived the exact fact needed in step 3.1: scalar densities, independent product law, Tonelli and Borel product-Lebesgue agreement give G a product density; the inverse invertible linear image of the closed null boundary is null, so H-b charges it zero. Checked empty/whole-space sublevels, symmetric convex closures, Lipschitz distances, separate centering of summands, and the threshold-grid error <= M/N. AC supplies countable choice; Statement unchanged.

The positive-dimension Gaussian, compactness and sphere suppliers do not prove the dimension-zero interpretation. Preserved the Statement and supplied its singleton case: the only prior is already finite and all rules have risk g(0). For d>=1, repaired the independently observed F1 density overstatement via scalar product densities and affine C1 change of variables. Verified the envelope, compact uniform TV continuity, rule-uniform risk bound, finite Borel partition and prior tail, including M=0 and B=0. Adopted precheck phase renumbering without changing the argument. AC retained; no selector or new item.

The IID CLT requires finite d>=1, omitted from F3, and does not cover the empty-tuple case. Preserved the Statement and supplied a dimension-zero branch with equal local/base laws, L_n=1 and the unique singleton central-sequence law. F3 now states d>=1, and F6 cites the centered QMD score before the positive-dimension CLT. Read the complete score and normalized-product arguments: normalization, singular-mass TV error and sequence expansion are sound. Adopted precheck phase renumbering only. Singular information remains allowed; no full likelihood ratio or compact-uniform LAN is asserted.
